ai_review.summary: High‑quality audience recording captures the vibe of a classic GD night, though specific performance details are scarce
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises the excellent audience tape quality, calling it “great AUD” and thanking the tapers for their work. No musical specifics or standout moments are mentioned, so the show's performance can’t be evaluated beyond being an enjoyable historic fragment.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong positive feedback on recording quality but only one review and no details about the musical performance, leading to a solid yet cautious rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer notes great audience capture with clear sound; taps praised for preserving the venue ambience.
